title: Register version record frontmatter (HANDOFF-LEGO-PIPE-032-R1, R0 §4 items 3 and 8)
description: One immutable record per landed register version under docs/correspondence/register/versions/<v>.md. The body after the second --- fence is the note bytes, byte-exact, digested by note_sha256. The oneOf below encodes R0 §4 item 3's per-kind table exactly: a record that satisfies none of the three branches, or carries a key its branch forbids, fails validation. Chain-boundary rule (previous_version null only on the manifest's lowest_version record) is RL-06's, not this schema's; this schema only forbids null on finalized and bootstrap records. No landing_pr, timestamp, author or landing-head field exists on any kind (RR-32-05, RR-32-R2-03).

oneOf.x-kind: migrated — produced by register_migrate.py once against the base bytes; exactly one of slice/resolution; resolution-bearing records also carry shared_slice: true and an anomaly id, slice-bearing records may carry neither; never finalized_from_main / affected_memos / allocations_consumed / manifest_ref / corrects

finalized — produced by register_finalize.py on every ordinary landing; requires finalized_from_main, affected_memos, allocations_consumed; previous_version never null; never slice/resolution/shared_slice/anomaly/manifest_ref

bootstrap — the Q-12 alternative James did not take; kept so RL-17 can reject one if it ever appears; requires manifest_ref; previous_version never null; never finalized_from_main/slice/resolution/shared_slice/anomaly/affected_memos/allocations_consumed/corrects
